text:
anya: Heads-up sync 10min. We need a clear roadmap for regional/residency routing presets so sales can promise migrations Hosted->Dedicated->Private.

sam: Agreed. Can we break requirements into three axes: latency affinity, legal residency, tenant isolation?

mohit: Yes. Model as a 3-tuple policy: (region_affinity, residency_lane, isolation_level). Keep resolution deterministic.

rachel: Customers want one switch though. Recommend opinionated presets: `low-latency`, `eu-residency`, `isolated`. Presets expand to policy tuples.

julia: Presets + preview UI in Console. Show routes, estimated cost delta, and fallbacks.

anya: Proposed launch criteria for a preset: 1) perf baselines across US/EU, 2) cross-region failover adds <2s, 3) canary run 48h at 5% traffic, 4) model-variant compatibility matrix published, 5) KMS & audit log checklist (for residency).

sam: Add compatibility block: if a model variant isn't available in a region, fallbacks must be explicit. Document what "compatible" means (quantized vs float).

mohit: Draft policy proto for compiler: `policy = {preset: "eu-residency", allowed_regions: ["eu-central-1"], isolation: "hard", fallbacks: ["same-region-quant","cross-region-compatible"]}`. Resolution order: health > latency > cost.

rachel: Ops/legal asks: retention SLAs for audit logs (some customers need >=2y). Include KMS/HSM integration steps in checklist.

julia: Start region support small: US-WEST + EU-CENTRAL for beta. Makes testing tractable.

anya: Milestones (draft):
- M1 (policy model + compiler v0, unit tests, Console preview)
- M2 (routing engine integration, internal canary, model-variant tooling)
- M3 (public beta with presets, audit logs, KMS integration for 2-region pair)
- M4 (enterprise migration tooling + private option)

sam: Suggest M2->M3 gap short if we limit to 2 regions.

mohit: Need migration playbook template: traffic split plan, KV cache warmup, tokenization parity checks, fallback rehearsal. I'll add synthetic load script for canary.

rachel: I'll own playbook + legal checklist.

deploy-bot: deployed policy-compiler/v0 to staging at 3101240000 :rocket:

anya: Action items:
- mohit: PR for compiler + synthetic tests (EOW)
- rachel: playbook template + legal checklist (next Wed)
- sam: model-variant matrix draft (2w)
- julia: console preview wireframes (10d)

anya: If no objections by EOD, I'll fold into roadmap doc. :white_check_mark:
